about: The status presets, written as data: one board, one filter, and what each surface keeps.
Both evaluators replay it. `src-tauri/tests/operations/preset_conformance.rs` runs every case
through `crate::filters`; `src/utils/preset-conformance.test.ts` runs the same case through
`filter-tree.ts` and `list-filter.ts`. Neither side generates this file, so a rule changed in
one language and not the other turns the other language red on the case it broke.
A node carries only the facts a filter reads. `hasTodoChild` is never written here: both sides
derive it from the node's own children, because that is what the rule is about. The `root`
node frames each board — it is never a row and never appears in an expectation.
`filter.preset` is the shared status preset. `filter.unblock` is the List View's sixth option,
which does not replace the preset: it leaves it where it was and adds `blocked rows only`.
`filter.expectations` is the List View's Expectations option, which, like Unblock, leaves the
preset where it was. A case's `expectations` lists the Expectation rows the List View keeps;
omitted, it is empty. A delegated Task's virtual Expectation and an Expectation's virtual
check task are written into a board as the ordinary nodes they are drawn as.

cases.name: all shows the whole board
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — All shows everything, containers included.

cases.name: plan hides done tasks, resolved goals and effectively-archived items
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — Plan: hide done tasks, achieved/frozen/archived goals, and anything whose effective Archival is Archived. A Frozen or Archived Project goes with its whole subtree; Achieved keeps ordinary ancestor-keeping. An active Aspect/Domain/Project shows on its own. A Commitment shows under Plan only while unresolved: Kept and Broken are both answered, as a done Task is (resources.md, Commitments).

cases.name: start drops lapsed windows, bare in-progress tasks and blocked subtrees
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — Start: Plan, minus in-progress tasks with no todo child, minus Timing-Lapsed items, minus Habit flow nodes; a blocked task/goal is dropped together with its whole subtree. A container shows only as the ancestor of a content match.

cases.name: do shows in-progress tasks and the containers carrying them
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — Do: only in-progress tasks; goals and structure appear solely as ancestors.

cases.name: backlog shows what was set aside, and everything beneath it
cases.spec: resources.md — Backlog: only Tasks deliberately set aside, together with their whole subtrees. A Commitment has no Backlog state to be in.

cases.name: unblock over all shows every blocked task and empties the commitments band
cases.spec: list-view.md — Unblock shows every blocked task, List-View-only, and leaves the shared preset alone. Unblock and Backlog leave the commitments section empty.

cases.name: unblock over start still shows every blocked task
cases.spec: list-view.md — Unblock replaces the preset's rules for the list rather than combining with them, so the list reads the shared preset as All. It has to: Start hides a blocked task together with its subtree, which is exactly the set Unblock exists to show. The preset still answers for the Mindmap, which keeps it.

cases.name: the archived pill on include force-shows archived items under plan
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — Archived Include force-shows archived items even under Plan/Start.

cases.name: the archived pill on exclude hides archived subtrees even under all
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — Archived Exclude force-hides archived items even under All, hard-hiding the whole subtree.

cases.name: the backlog pill on include force-shows set-aside work under plan
cases.spec: resources.md / mindmap-view.md — Backlog Include force-shows backlogged Tasks under Plan/Start.

cases.name: the backlog pill on exclude hides set-aside subtrees even under all
cases.spec: resources.md / mindmap-view.md — Backlog Exclude force-hides backlogged Tasks even under All, subtree and all.

cases.name: private mode off hard-hides a private subtree under all
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — while Private Mode is off, every node marked Private is hard-hidden together with its whole subtree.

cases.name: private mode on reveals the private subtree
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — turning Private Mode on reveals them.

cases.name: a tag filter in any mode keeps only the tagged content
cases.spec: filtering-logic.md — (union of Any-filters) AND (intersection of All-filters) AND NOT (union of Exclusion-filters).

cases.name: a tag filter in exclusion mode drops the tagged content
cases.spec: filtering-logic.md — Exclusion: item must not match any Exclusion-mode filter.

cases.name: two tag filters in all mode need both tags
cases.spec: filtering-logic.md — All: item must match every All-mode filter.

cases.name: info notes ride along but never keep a node on screen
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — Info notes are attachments: they ride along with a kept node but never keep one.

cases.name: start hides a habit flow and everything in it
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — Start drops Habit flow nodes.

cases.name: plan keeps flows while the include-flows subtoggle is on
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — an Include flows subtoggle, shown only in Plan/Start.

cases.name: plan drops flows once the include-flows subtoggle is off
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — both the global Flow toggle and the per-preset subtoggle must be on for flows to show.

cases.name: an unopened habit occurrence shows under all
cases.spec: habits.md — an occurrence whose window has not opened is Pending, and All shows it.

cases.name: plan hides an unopened habit occurrence and its subtree
cases.spec: habits.md — every preset but All hides an unopened occurrence, together with its own subtree; the commitments band walks for it as the task rows do.

cases.name: backlog hides an unopened habit occurrence and the work set aside inside it
cases.spec: habits.md — Backlog hides an unopened occurrence like every preset but All: an unopened window is not work somebody set aside. Work genuinely set aside under an *open* occurrence still shows.

cases.name: a status-less container inherits its nearest status-bearing ancestor
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — a status-less container inherits the nearest status-bearing ancestor's status; one with no status-bearing ancestor at all reads as Active.

cases.name: do shows a backlogged in-progress task
cases.spec: resources.md — Backlog says "not planning this now" and Do asks "what is underway": a Task can answer yes to both, so Do shows a backlogged in-progress Task. (Setting a Task In Progress clears the flag, so the pair is reached by setting aside work already under way.)

cases.name: the archived pill on exclude still hides an archived task under do
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — the Archived pill reads the same way under every preset, Do included: Exclude hard-hides an effectively-archived in-progress Task there too.

cases.name: the archived pill on include force-shows an archived commitment under do
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — the Archived pill reads the same way under every preset, Do included: Include force-shows an archived Commitment there.

cases.name: a commitment under an unopened occurrence is hidden with its parent
cases.spec: habits.md / list-view.md — an unopened occurrence hides together with its own subtree, and the commitments band answers that subtree rule like every other surface.

cases.name: all shows every expectation, released and archived ones included
cases.spec: resources.md, Expectations — a released or archived Expectation shows under All only.

cases.name: plan shows pending expectations and hides a delegated task that still keeps its wait on screen
cases.spec: resources.md, Expectations — All and Plan show a pending Expectation; released and archived ones show under All only. A delegated Task has every effect of archival; its virtual Expectation shows under the Expectation rules while the Task is not done.

cases.name: start shows a pending expectation only when it has no check-by, and the check task under the ordinary task rules
cases.spec: resources.md, Expectations — Start shows a pending Expectation only when it has no check-by; the virtual check task follows the ordinary Task preset rules. A task depending on a pending Expectation is blocked. A wait whose own Time Scope has lapsed drops out of Start, as a Task's does.

cases.name: do shows no expectation
cases.spec: resources.md, Expectations — every preset but All, Plan and Start hides a pending Expectation.

cases.name: backlog shows no expectation
cases.spec: resources.md, Expectations — a wait cannot be set aside.

cases.name: the expectations option shows every pending live expectation and no task rows
cases.spec: list-view.md — the Expectations option shows pending, live Expectations and nothing else; the Mindmap ignores it.

cases.name: the expectations option ignores the preset it leaves behind
cases.spec: list-view.md — like Unblock, the Expectations option replaces the preset's rules for the list rather than combining with them.

cases.name: unblock shows the task a pending expectation blocks and no expectation
cases.spec: resources.md, Expectations — a Task depending on a pending Expectation is virtually blocked; a wait is never blocked itself.

cases.name: the archived pill on include force-shows archived expectations and delegated tasks under plan
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — Include force-shows anything whose effective Archival is Archived; a delegated Task has every effect of archival.

cases.name: the archived pill on exclude hides archived expectations and delegated subtrees under all
cases.spec: mindmap-view.md — Exclude hard-hides the whole subtree of anything archived; a delegated Task has every effect of archival. In the flat list the pill hides the archived row itself, as it does for task rows: an excluded ancestor does not gate a row there, so the delegated Task's wait stays in the list while the Mindmap drops it with its Task.

cases.name: all and a kept or broken commitment whose window is still open
cases.spec: resources.md, Commitments — Plan, Start and Do show only unresolved Commitments: Kept and Broken are both answered, the way a done Task is, window open or not. All shows every verdict; Backlog shows none.

cases.name: plan and a kept or broken commitment whose window is still open
cases.spec: resources.md, Commitments — Plan, Start and Do show only unresolved Commitments: Kept and Broken are both answered, the way a done Task is, window open or not. All shows every verdict; Backlog shows none.

cases.name: start and a kept or broken commitment whose window is still open
cases.spec: resources.md, Commitments — Plan, Start and Do show only unresolved Commitments: Kept and Broken are both answered, the way a done Task is, window open or not. All shows every verdict; Backlog shows none.

cases.name: do and a kept or broken commitment whose window is still open
cases.spec: resources.md, Commitments — Plan, Start and Do show only unresolved Commitments: Kept and Broken are both answered, the way a done Task is, window open or not. All shows every verdict; Backlog shows none.

cases.name: backlog and a kept or broken commitment whose window is still open
cases.spec: resources.md, Commitments — Plan, Start and Do show only unresolved Commitments: Kept and Broken are both answered, the way a done Task is, window open or not. All shows every verdict; Backlog shows none.

cases.name: a tag filter judges an expectation's own tags
cases.spec: resources.md, Expectations — a wait carries tags like a Task, and the tag filters read them the same way.
